item.title: 2008 Mercedes-Benz CLK550 Cabriolet at No Reserve
item.description: This 2008 Mercedes-Benz CLK550 cabriolet has 79k miles following registration history in Georgia and Florida, and was purchased by the seller in 2025. It is powered by a 5.5-liter V8 paired with a seven-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Majestic Black Metallic over gray leather. item.title: Neon Sinclair Dino Sign at No Reserve
item.description: This neon Sinclair sign is a reproduction piece in the shape of the company’s dinosaur logo and displays Sinclair and Dino lettering. It measures around 63″ wide by 36″ tall by 6″ deep, and the neon tubes are powered by 120-volt wiring with two power cords. This neon Sinclair sign was acquired by the seller in 2025 and is now offered at no reserve in Fort Collins, Colorado, with a wooden shipping pallet.

item.description: This 2012 Ford Mustang Boss 302 is #513 of approximately 767 Laguna Seca coupes produced for the model year, and it has 24 miles. The car remained with its original owner in their collection from new up until it was recently acquired by the selling dealer, and it is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission and a Torsen limited-slip differential.
